text_en: Required analyses (physico-chemical, parasite eggs) must be present and still valid (Batch.analysis_status = valid). tag.source: Arrete du Ministre de l'Agriculture du 21 juin 1994, as summarised in Benabdallah S. (2003) 'La reutilisation des eaux usees traitees en Tunisie', Tableau 10 p.15

text_en: The crop must be on the list fixed by the 21 June 1994 order (industrial crops, cereals, fodder, fodder shrubs, forest trees; fruit trees only if not sprinkler-irrigated). Olive and alfalfa are allowed by interpretation (TO_VERIFY against the full order).
text_fr: La culture doit figurer sur la liste de l'arrete du 21 juin 1994 (cultures industrielles, cereales, fourrages, arbustes fourragers, arbres forestiers ; arbres fruitiers seulement sans aspersion). Olivier et luzerne : par interpretation (A VERIFIER).

tag.source: https://faolex.fao.org/docs/pdf/tun204032.pdf

text_en: Vegetable crops (cultures maraicheres) and crops eaten raw (crudites) cannot be irrigated with treated wastewater.
text_fr: L'irrigation des cultures maraicheres et des crudites par eaux usees traitees est interdite (decret 89-1047, art. 5).

tag.source: https://faolex.fao.org/docs/pdf/tun204032.pdf

text_en: Direct grazing on plots irrigated with treated wastewater is prohibited.
text_fr: Le paturage direct sur les parcelles irriguees par eaux usees traitees est interdit.

tag.source: https://faolex.fao.org/docs/pdf/tun204032.pdf

text_en: Fodder crop: cut-and-carry only, no direct grazing.
text_fr: Culture fourragere : fauche et affouragement uniquement, pas de paturage direct.
